notes.title: Fixed crucial bugs
notes.content:
I've fixed some bugs that have arisen after updating from Unity 5.3 to 5.4. 

*spoilers ahead*

- Items are now removed after using them
- You can get the bone from the chicken man now

http://i.imgur.com/SGsNARW.png 

Yay! Fun times with chicken bones! Sorry about these bugs; next time I update Unity, I'm double-checking everything.
